summary: SilverBullet is a self-hosted note-taking application tailored for technical users who prefer customisable, Markdown-based workflows. It provides an environment to capture, link, and organise text files directly on your own infrastructure. Falling under the note-taking and editor category, it functions as a lightweight personal knowledge base.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers and power users who want local control over their Markdown notes and prefer customisable, hacker-friendly tooling.
watchOut: The ecosystem is niche and has a steeper learning curve compared to mainstream note-taking tools, meaning you may need to configure and maintain your own plugins or extensions.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to map a persistent volume for your note storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
